title: Human-AI Collaboration in Customer Behavior Research: Personalizing Financial Services
venue: Journal of Computer Science and Technology Studies
tldr: Human-AI collaborative framework combines machine learning on transactional data with human contextual intelligence for financial services personalization.
problem_and_motivation: Financial institutions face substantial hurdles in executing effective personalization strategies including data integration, talent acquisition, and regulatory compliance.
approach: Reviews evolution from demographic segmentation to AI-driven behavioral analytics in financial services.
Proposes human-AI collaborative framework where ML models process transactional data and human experts provide interpretive insights.
Examines knowledge collaboration frameworks, ethical oversight, and adaptive expertise integration.
Discusses operationalization through execution architecture and omnichannel orchestration.
Presents JP Morgan Chase case study of human-AI collaborative platform.
findings: Human-guided AI models achieve higher accuracy in predicting customer financial needs than fully automated systems.
Financial institutions using advanced analytics show improvement in customer retention metrics.

definitions.definition: Symbiotic partnership where AI computational capabilities complement human contextual understanding.

citations.author: None
citations.claim: Conceptual paper drawing on industry sources rather than academic citations.

topic_relevance.contribution_to_field: This conceptual paper provides a framework for integrating human expertise with AI systems in financial customer analytics. It identifies areas where human contextual intelligence adds value beyond purely algorithmic approaches.
directly_justifies: Human-AI collaborative models improve customer retention and service adoption.
Human expertise provides essential interpretation layers for AI-generated insights.
limits: Relies on secondary industry sources rather than primary research.
topic_relevance.topic_mapping_rationale: Systematic scan across all 14 topic domains. Flagged 4.A (high), 5.A, 10.A, 11.A (medium). Rejected 1.A-2.D, 4.B-8.C, 9.A-14.C. Paper is a conceptual review, not empirical.

limitations: Conceptual paper without primary empirical validation.
Relies on industry examples and secondary sources. [unacknowledged]
remember_this: Human-AI collaboration outperforms purely algorithmic approaches.
AI excels at pattern recognition while humans provide contextual intelligence.
Trust and transparency are critical for financial AI adoption.
